fusions.name: Column Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the fork around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 6% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +36%).

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Road Pole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Heel and Toe
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
